description:
This is a wide, paved two-lane road with clear lane markings and streetlights, but there are no visible sidewalks, curb ramps, or dedicated pedestrian crossings. Traffic is separated only by painted centerlines and edge lines, with no physical barriers; the roadside is mostly open landscaping and low vegetation, offering limited shade and little pedestrian protection.

The road surface appears smooth and continuous, and there are few immediate obstacles along the shoulder, but the lack of a defined walking path and minimal accessibility features reduce walkability and pedestrian comfort.
